usage_note: Only the head noun 'rinktinė' declines (feminine ė-stem); the genitive modifiers 'Latvijos vyrų ledo ritulio' stay fixed. In running sports copy the team is usually called 'Latvijos rinktinė' (rinktinės, rinktinei, rinktinę…), simply 'Latvija' (declined as a normal country name), or 'latviai' (plural, masculine) for the players. 'Vyrų' is usually omitted unless needed to distinguish the team from the women's team.
